newsitem.title: USA: RSL Communications raises ITG stake to 88 pct.
newsitem.headline: RSL Communications raises ITG stake to 88 pct.

text.p: RSL Communications said Monday that it raised its stake in International Telecommunications Group Ltd (ITG) to 88 percent from 50 percent.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

RSL, a global telecommunications company which owns, operates and develops international facilities-based telecommunications companies, said in a statement that the move signaled the expansion of its U.S. operations.
ITG is the sixth-largest facilities-based international carrier in the United States.
